name: Star Characterization Equivalence
hypotheses: Finite connected graph; the obstruction criterion assumes a partial cube.
statement: The star, diameter-two tree, and two-obstruction criteria define the same class.
proof: A tree has diameter at most two exactly when all edges meet one center. Avoiding $C_4$ first forces a partial cube to be a tree; a tree with no convex $P_4$ has diameter at most two and hence is a star.
